alternating_dual_embedding.family: place any tensor P on one hyperedge colour and dual(P) on the other
alternating_dual_embedding.global_duality: duality exchanges the two cell colours, so the alternating model is selfdual
alternating_dual_embedding.structural_result: a selfdual embedding of an arbitrary site probability exists only as an inhomogeneous dual pair; it does not impose an exact equation on the homogeneous square-site threshold

not_proved: a no-go for arbitrarily large decorated cells or nonlocal projections
any new numerical or closed-form value of square-site pc
proved: the all-or-none embedding and its unique local selfdual point
the exact two-block composition tensor and no common selfdual root
the no-go for the full correlated (a,b,b,c) two-block family

decision.next_live_route: a successful exact embedding must use a nonlocal projection or a larger cell whose terminal semantics no longer identify P4 directly with the site occupation probability
decision.result: finite-local obstruction for the homogeneous Bernoulli slice, plus an exact correlated positive family
decision.square_site_implication: local four-edge duality either fixes the exact Bernoulli tensor at 1/2, generates partial connectivity couplings, or alternates p with 1-p; none yields a new exact constraint on homogeneous square-site pc

exact_square_site_embedding.meaning: a Bernoulli site is exactly the all-or-none correlated four-terminal hyperedge

finite_local_correlated_no_go.family: for either C4 orientation let Prob(00)=a, Prob(10)=Prob(01)=b, Prob(11)=c, with a+2b+c=1
finite_local_correlated_no_go.meaning: any nonzero single-block state generates an unpaired P2 direction; selfduality forces perfect 00/11 correlation and collapses the composite back to the all-or-none t=1/2 tensor

maximal_positive_correlated_family.consequence: adding dual-paired partial states yields a genuine two-dimensional selfdual correlated-cell manifold, but moves P4 downward from 1/2 and cannot preserve an all-connected marginal above 1/2

minimal_composition_obstruction.construction: two all-or-none four-hyperedges share two internal vertices; average the AB|CD and BC|DA orientations to restore C4
minimal_composition_obstruction.proof: P3-P2=-t(1-t)/2 forces t=0 or 1, while P4-P1=2t-1 forces t=1/2
